verified_public_facts.fact: Effective September 30, 2025, an adopted person age 18 or older may request the contents of the adoption file from the Ohio Department of Health; the request requires an address, notarized signature, two identification items, and the required fee.

An adopted person age 18 or older may request nonidentifying information about birth parents or birth siblings from the agency, attorney, or probate court that holds or finalized the adoption records.
Ohio law separately addresses release of adoption-file contents for adopted persons age 21 or older and adoptive parents of adoptees age 18 through 20, subject to the statute's release/denial rules.
The current Ohio Supreme Court probate forms index includes adoption forms 18.0 through 18.9 and adult-adoption forms 19.0 through 19.4.
